title: REC & PFC Sign ₹26,850 Crore Loan Agreement for 2,400 MW Meja Thermal Power Project
summary: Finances 3 Ultra-Super Critical units of 800 MW each at Meja, Uttar Pradesh.

blocks.content: Finances 3 Ultra-Super Critical units of 800 MW each at Meja, Uttar Pradesh.

items: Financing Structure: REC and PFC equal 50:50 debt funding of ₹26,850 crore for MUNPL (50:50 JV between NTPC and UPRVUNL).
Project Completion Cost: Estimated at ₹38,357.81 crore equipped with Air Cooled Condenser (ACC) system.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: REC Chairman & MD: Jitendra Srivastava | PFC CMD: Parminder Chopra.
